configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Debug build that places FetchContent downloads for pybind11 and transitive native dependencies under $FETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR so they survive `rm -rf build/`. Requires the env var to be set (scripts/dev.sh sets it).

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Release build for performance work: builds _native and libpinpoint_cpp with -O3. Deliberately does NOT use $FETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR: the shared cache holds Debug-built dependency objects, and mixing build types in one FetchContent binary dir corrupts both trees.
